hooks.command:
[ -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.gotdocs/INDEX.md" ] || exit 0
printf "%s\n" "gotdocs is enabled in this repo. Documentation lives in the repo and is enforced: read .gotdocs/INDEX.md first - one line per doc, grouped by type, with a Decisions section listing the architecture decisions in force - and open only the docs you need. .gotdocs/index.json is the machine-readable form of the same data. Commands: bin/gotdocs status | bin/gotdocs impacted <path> | bin/gotdocs check --staged | bin/gotdocs verify <id> | bin/gotdocs why \"<what you observed>\" | bin/gotdocs debt list. A doc goes stale when code matching its covers globs changes and the doc is neither edited nor verified; the pre-commit hook reports this and records what you let through in .gotdocs/debt.jsonl. Before calling behavior a bug, run bin/gotdocs why - an accepted decision record may already explain it. Skills: gotdocs-update, gotdocs-author, gotdocs-audit, gotdocs-install."
exit 0
